capture.title: Describe Your Project
capture.subtitle: Describe the work in your own words. VisionWorx360 Pro builds the scope of work and estimate.
capture.disclaimer: Review and confirm each item before it enters the estimate.

project.title: Project
project.none: Create a project first to capture scope.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.placeholder: Speak, or type what you see on site…
transcript.hint: You can edit the transcript at any time. It is saved on this device so you can resume later.

offline.unsupportedBody: This browser can't listen right now. Type or paste the walkthrough below — everything else works the same.
offline.deniedBody: Allow microphone access in your browser settings, then start recording again. Your transcript is saved.
offline.errorBody: The partial transcript was saved. Edit it below or start recording again.

review.empty: No scope items detected yet. Record or type a walkthrough, then review again.

toast.failed: Could not add these items. Please try again.

save.title: Save your work
save.leaveWarning: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
save.error: Could not save to the project. Please try again.
save.errorBody: We couldn't save this project description to the server. Your text is still here — check your connection and try again.

recorder.successHint: Your recording was added to the transcript.

permission_denied.title: Microphone blocked
permission_denied.body: Allow microphone access for this site, then tap record again. Anything you typed is kept.

no_microphone.title: No microphone found
no_microphone.body: Connect or enable a microphone, then try again. You can type the note instead.

insecure_context.title: Recording not available here
insecure_context.body: This page must be opened over a secure (https) connection to record. Type the note instead.

unsupported.title: Recording not supported
unsupported.body: This browser can't record audio. Type the note instead — everything else works the same.

empty.title: Nothing recorded
empty.body: We didn't hear anything. Tap record and speak again, or type the note.

no_audio.title: No audio detected
no_audio.body: The microphone did not detect speech. Check the selected microphone and record again.

network_failed.title: Connection interrupted
network_failed.body: The recording is kept. Check your connection, then retry transcription.

transcription_unavailable.title: Transcription unavailable
transcription_unavailable.body: The recording is kept. Retry shortly or record again.

unsupported_audio.title: Audio format not supported
unsupported_audio.body: This browser produced an unreadable recording. Record again using another browser if it continues.

audio_too_large.title: Recording too long
audio_too_large.body: Record a shorter note, then continue with another recording.

transcription_failed.title: Could not transcribe
transcription_failed.body: The recording didn't come back as text. Try again, or type the note. Nothing you wrote was lost.

recorder_failed.title: Recording failed
recorder_failed.body: The microphone stopped unexpectedly. Tap record to try again, or type the note.
